home.why_text: We are in the business of exiting clients out of assets and into opportunities. We broker with a cycle-awareness approach with the goal of transforming client equity into cash flowing investments. We help transition local capital into out of state opportunities. With a middle market focus, we advise generational ownership and institutional funds.

careers.who_text: Exodus Capital is a leading commercial real estate investment sales brokerage specializing in the Tri-State Area. We focus on transitioning client equity into cash-flowing investments, advising both generational property owners and institutional funds. Since our founding in 2022, we have successfully sold over 700,000 square feet of commercial properties, totaling more than $270 million in sales volume.
careers.apply_text: We're a top-revered team, with a wealth of knowledge among the Tri State area and aggressively growing our sales team. Fill out your information below and one of our recruiters will get in touch with you.

slides.title: How do we stimulate market activity?

approach.title: Equity Evaluation
approach.text: What is your building worth in today’s market? This is when we underwrite and articulate the value of your asset and lay out a blueprint on how to maximize your proceeds.

approach.title: Boots on the Ground
approach.text: How do you stimulate market activity? We exclusively engage the market with a constant contact approach. We pick up the phone and make direct calls to all the usual suspects, exchange buyers, and any neighboring assets. After initial market feedback, we take a data driven approach in which we leverage a market-wide process to uncover new equity sources.

approach.title: Market Pollination
approach.text: Who’s in your network? With organic market crossover, this allows us to leverage existing relationships and widen our buyer pool through in-house and external brokers.

approach.title: Transitional Real Estate
approach.text: You sold my property, now what? Once we sell your building, we take a hands-on approach during your time-sensitive 1031 exchange process. With our Horvath & Tremblay partnership of net leased inventory and multifamily apartments throughout the U.S., we collectively help you identify a 1031 solution.

partnership.intro_text: Horvath & Tremblay is one of the most active and successful investment real estate brokerage firms in the United States. Their advisors specialize in the sale of single-tenant net-lease, multi-tenant retail, apartment, and mixed-use properties. They have experience in successfully structuring sale lease-back programs, portfolio dispositions, and 1031 exchanges. With a dedicated 1031 buy-side desk that provides real-time inventory and market data to each individual client, they have the national capability to place capital.

accordion.title: Collaborative Culture
accordion.text: Designed without private offices, our open floor layout allows for information to move quickly and efficiently throughout our entire organization. This culture ensures that our entire company works together to effectively achieve exceptional execution and unmatched results for our clients.

accordion.title: Relationship Focused
accordion.text: Our relationships are more important than any individual transaction. We invest the time and resources to fully understand our client’s motivations and goals. This enables us to approach each assignment with a focus on the long term success of our clients.

accordion.title: Defined Expertise
accordion.text: Our firm, comprised of highly skilled Investment Real Estate Advisors, specializes in the sale of single tenant net-lease, multi-tenant retail, apartment and mixed-use properties. Each advisor is assigned a specific geographical area. This specialization helps us skillfully navigate and negotiate real estate transactions within each local submarket. Our advisors have a long track record of helping to achieve superior results for private investors, developers, institutions and industry professionals.
